description: Cancel an open limit order: returns the UNSIGNED cancel transaction (Solana) or the cancellation typed data (EVM, no gas) for the maker's wallet to sign, then submit_limit_order. An order that was never submitted is cancelled at once (nothing to sign). Confirm with the user first. The LayerHop MCP server holds no private keys and never signs or broadcasts transactions.
name: cancel_limit_order
title: Cancel a limit order (unsigned)
